description: This file defines the 'Floor' class which implements various flooring functions such as FLOOR, FLOOR.MATH, and FLOOR.PRECISE used for rounding numbers down to specified multiples within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Floor
classes.description: A class providing static methods for various flooring operations, including FLOOR, FLOOR.MATH, and FLOOR.PRECISE, used for rounding numbers down to specified multiples in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Rounds a number down, toward zero, to the nearest multiple of significance, with support for array inputs.

methods.name: math
methods.description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer or multiple of significance, with optional mode for negative numbers, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: precise
methods.description: Rounds a number down, toward zero, to the nearest multiple of significance, similar to FLOOR.PRECISE, with support for array inputs.

methods.name: argumentsOkPrecise
methods.description: Helper method to validate arguments for the precise rounding method, handling zero significance and zero input cases.

methods.name: argsOk
methods.description: Helper method to validate arguments for FLOOR and FLOOR.MATH, performing the actual rounding logic based on input parameters.

methods.name: floorMathTest
methods.description: Helper method to determine whether to use ceiling rounding based on input signs and mode.

methods.name: argumentsOk
methods.description: Handles validation and rounding logic for standard floor operations, considering the signs of inputs.
